caption: The drawing depicts a rural scene set against a blue background. In the foreground, there are two large birds, a hen and a rooster, rendered in shades of beige, brown, and white with patterned feather details. Smaller birds are depicted around their feet. The midground features a body of water with numerous yellow and brown lily pads floating on the surface. On the left side, there are several stylized trees with dark brown and yellow foliage. In the background, a group of human figures and two cows are placed near the water, with buildings sitting further back. Among the buildings, there is a prominent church with a large entrance and a tall spire, colored in light pink, beige, and white. The scene also includes several hills and additional trees painted in dark earthy tones, which frame the buildings and church in the distance. The entire composition is bordered by the cream color of the paper.
title: Bandbox
